items.title: 2 Profitable Stocks for Long-Term Investors and 1 We Ignore
items.summary: While profitability is essential, it doesn’t guarantee long-term success. Some companies that rest on their margins will lose ground as competition intensifies — as Jeff Bezos said, “Your margin is my opportunity”.

items.title: ‘Apple and Microsoft Look Like Value Stocks’: Morningstar on SanDisk’s 2,107% Year
items.summary: A single flash-memory stock has quietly redrawn the boundary between growth and value investing, leaving retirement savers in supposedly defensive index funds holding far more AI-cycle risk than they realize.

items.title: Prediction: This AI Stock Could Be the Next One to Shock Wall Street
items.summary: Micron has already stunned Wall Street with a historic surge, but a fresh competitive threat just knocked shares down and reignited the debate over whether the AI memory trade still has legs or has finally run out of road.

items.title: Can Seagate Sustain Its Strong Revenue Growth in Fiscal 2027?
items.summary: STX expects fiscal 2027 revenue growth to exceed fiscal 2026 as cloud demand, AI adoption and HAMR expansion support mass-capacity storage.

items.title: Micron Could Be the Next Nvidia For Patient Investors
items.summary: Micron has already posted a 662% one-year gain on the AI memory boom, but our proprietary model puts its 12-month price target below where the stock trades today, and the reasoning challenges everything the bull case assumes.

items.title: Memory Stocks Slide as Rates and Oil Swamp JPMorgan’s Overweight Call: SK Hynix Sinks 5%, Western Digital Drops 3%, Micron Slips
items.summary: JPMorgan just slapped an Overweight rating on SK Hynix with a price target well above current levels, yet the stock is sinking anyway as surging Treasury yields and triple-digit oil prices gut the bull case in real time.

items.title: SanDisk Traded Its Best Prices For Something Rarer
items.summary: SanDisk (SNDK) shares changed hands at $70.50 a year ago. They now sit at $1,737.99. Flash prices rose over that stretch, and the whole memory group rose with them, so part of this is the cycle. The rest is what SanDisk did while it held the leverage, and that part comes with a bill.

items.title: Seagate's HAMR Bet is Paying Off: Can Mozaic Sustain the Momentum?
items.summary: STX's HAMR and Mozaic roadmap is boosting storage capacity, exabyte growth and efficiency as demand for higher-capacity drives rises.
